copy.title: Rotation
howTo: Each seat ramps up, peaks, then declines into entrenchment.
Rotate a seat in its sweet spot — when it reads Ready.
Too early wastes the ramp; too late is careerism.
Grandfathered incumbents are exempt — let their terms expire.
endLines: Rotate at the service sweet spot.
Too early wastes the ramp; too late breeds careerism.
copy.shareText: I rotated every seat at the service sweet spot in Rotation — service, not careerism. Beat my score.
